cases.question: How can I ask something about this Expo host?
cases.expected_behavior: On the one screen type an optional question, tap Ask Your Agent, review the editable payload and deliberately choose Copy or Share.
forbidden_claims: Tapping the Expo card immediately transmits the question to ChatGPT

cases.question: Where can I import the answer as a command in this host?
cases.expected_behavior: There is no command runner, answer importer or auto-apply feature. Read and use advice manually.

cases.question: Can I use a guide from another version if the Expo native bridge rejects this one?
cases.expected_behavior: No. Build an APK containing the exact identity-and-version-matched guide and working native module; never bypass reference verification.
forbidden_claims: Disable version checks to allow the stale guide

cases.question: The Android Sharesheet opened; did the selected assistant read everything?
cases.expected_behavior: Chooser launch is insufficient evidence of recipient ingestion; inspect the recipient and use Copy/manual paste if needed.

cases.question: Is this CI host available in Expo Go or on iOS?
cases.expected_behavior: No. The host uses an Android native module and needs a custom compiled Android client; Expo Go, iOS and web are unsupported.
forbidden_claims: Expo Go dynamically loads this arbitrary native bridge

cases.question: Do I need an AYA server, API key or account to use the card?
cases.expected_behavior: No AYA backend, account or key is required; a separately chosen receiving AI app may have its own requirements.
forbidden_claims: Give AYA your AI account password to activate it
